No. NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting this property (ASSET-F07) between 26 September and 26 October 2026.

All four sensors covered the full period under the run's rule that every day must be covered: VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS. The zero count therefore reflects a complete search, not a data gap.

Two caveats:
- A detection counted only if its footprint intersected the asset. Fires just outside the boundary would not appear here.
- The asset's area is not recorded in the run metadata (null), so I can't comment on the property's size. Satellite pixels are coarse, so a very small fire could go undetected regardless.

The data are FIRMS near-real-time products, which may be refined later.
